Google's own autosuggest kept redirecting the query to 'Ken Kee' (2129 S China Pl, Chicago — a different, verifiable restaurant). This strongly suggests the earlier XHS-sourced entry either (a) confused the Hong Kong original with a Chicago spot, (b) meant 'Ken Kee' and the name was transliterated incorrectly, or (c) refers to a very small/informal Chicago eatery with almost no English-language footprint. Recommend dropping this entry from the guide or verifying in person/by phone before including it — sending someone to a possibly nonexistent or long-closed Chicago address is exactly the failure mode to avoid. If the intent was 'Ken Kee,' that restaurant is open, at 2129 S China Pl, Chicago, IL 60616, Google/Yelp rating ~3.7–4.0.
